page: Microsoft Azure E8ns_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V and powered by a dedicated 5th Generation Intel Xeon 8573C processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture with a peak clock frequency of 4.2 GHz, this configuration provides 8 vCPUs mapped across 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The CPU subsystem features 260 MB of L3 cache alongside instruction set extensions including AVX-512, AMX (tile and int8), and VAES for accelerated matrix and cryptographic computing.

The instance delivers 64.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU allocation ratio. In benchmark evaluations, memory bandwidth achieves 608.18 GB/sec on cached read blocks and 61.47 GB/sec on large 256 MB reads, accompanied by 42.33 GB/sec in uncached write throughput. The instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring remote Premium Storage for persistent file systems, and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Compute benchmarking highlights balanced performance, led by strong single-threaded results. The system recorded a Geekbench single-core score of 2040.0, placing it in the upper quartile, alongside a multi-core score of 7492.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 14017.42. In-memory data workloads demonstrated solid capabilities, processing 10.8 million Redis SET operations per second and achieving a static web serving throughput of 14.36 GB/sec. Lightweight AI inference performs respectably on smaller models via AMX instructions, achieving 311.01 tokens per second on text generation with a 135M model, though throughput drops sharply to 8.17 tokens per second on a 7B model due to the absence of dedicated GPU hardware.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the E8ns_v6 provides high memory density per core without the cost overhead of integrated local NVMe storage arrays. It is best configured for memory-intensive enterprise tasks that rely on network storage, such as medium-sized relational databases, in-memory caching layers, Redis deployments, and data aggregation pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E8ns_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine running on an Intel Xeon 8573C processor at 4.2 GHz under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The x86_64 system includes 8 dedicated vCPUs spanning 4 physical cores, 260 MB of L3 cache, and 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not bundle local disk storage or hardware GPU acceleration, relying on network-attached Premium Storage for persistent data. Hardware capabilities include AVX-512 and AMX extensions, supporting strong single-core Geekbench performance (2040.0) and top-tier small-model LLM generation speeds (311.01 tokens/sec). In-memory performance remains robust, registering 10.8 million Redis SET operations per second and 61.47 GB/sec in large-block read throughput. The E8ns_v6 is engineered for memory-bound workloads such as transactional database engines, intermediate caching tiers, text processing, and backend analytics workloads.
